import sys, numpy as np
a = np.fromstring(sys.stdin.buffer.read(), dtype=np.int64, sep=' ')
a.sort(kind='stable')
n = a.size
if n == 0:
    sys.exit(0)
neg = a < 0
m = np.where(neg, -a, a).astype(np.uint64)
mx = int(m.max())
nd = len(str(mx))
W = nd + 1
buf = np.empty((n, W + 1), dtype=np.uint8)
buf[:, W] = 10
mask = np.empty((n, W + 1), dtype=bool)
mask[:, W] = True
ndig = np.ones(n, dtype=np.int64)
p = 10
for _ in range(nd - 1):
    ndig += (m >= p)
    p *= 10
q = m
for i in range(W - 1, 0, -1):
    q, r = np.divmod(q, np.uint64(10))
    buf[:, i] = r.astype(np.uint8) + 48
buf[:, 0] = 32
start = W - ndig
idx = np.arange(W)
mask[:, :W] = idx[None, :] >= start[:, None]
rows = np.nonzero(neg)[0]
if rows.size:
    cols = start[rows] - 1
    buf[rows, cols] = 45
    mask[rows, cols] = True
sys.stdout.buffer.write(buf[mask].tobytes())
